newsitem.title: USA: Typhoon threatens shipping off Philippines - WSC.
newsitem.headline: Typhoon threatens shipping off Philippines - WSC.

text.p: Typhoon Sally is becoming an increasing risk to shipping east of the northern Philippines, independent forecaster Weather Services Corp said on Friday.
Top winds are now 75 mph and they could reach 130 to 140 mph during the next 48-72 hours. Shipping is at risk due to strong winds and rough seas.

Sally is expected to be near the coast of north Luzon in about 48 hours, WSC said. Luzon may see heavy rains developing and gusty winds, and there could be mudslides in the north by the end of the weekend. If the typhoon's track is further south, the impact in Luzon would be greater.
